subject: Example of  KDE home range estimate superimposed on Google Maps

messages.author: 4d530e562601a179
messages.subject: Example of  KDE home range estimate superimposed on Google Maps
parts:
Hi,

I am fairly new to R and CTMM and am looking for a code example of superimposing the KDE / AKDE home range estimate onto Google maps. For example, fig. 6 of https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210X.12559 is the plot I would like to superimpose on Movebank gps data.

Many thanks

Christian

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Example of KDE home range estimate superimposed on Google Maps
parts:
Hi Christian,

For plotting onto Google maps, you would want to export to common spatial data formats: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/export.html
and then from there it should be more-or-less straightforward to work those in how you want.

For plotting onto Leaflet maps, there are ctmmweb functions for that: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmmwebdoc/reference/point_map.html

Inside ctmm, the base plot function also supports background polygons and rasters: https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/plot.telemetry.html

Best,
Chris
